title: 2018 AMC 10B Problem 4
statement: A three-dimensional rectangular box with dimensions \(X,\) \(Y,\) and \(Z\) has faces whose surface areas are \(24,\) \(24,\) \(48,\) \(48,\) \(72,\) and \(72\) square units. What is \(X + Y + Z?\)

solutions.text: The three distinct face areas are the pairwise products \(XY = 24,\) \(XZ = 48,\) \(YZ = 72\) in some order. Multiply all three: \((XYZ)^2 = 24 \cdot 48 \cdot 72 = 82944,\) so \(XYZ = 288.\) Now divide by each face area. We get \(Z = \frac{288}{24} = 12,\) \(Y = \frac{288}{48} = 6,\) and \(X = \frac{288}{72} = 4,\) so \(X + Y + Z = 22.\) Therefore, the answer is B.
hints: The three distinct face areas are the pairwise products \(XY, XZ, YZ,\) equal to \(24, 48, 72\)
Multiplying all three gives \((XYZ)^2;\) take the square root, then divide by each face area
